title: Seq.Filter frame repair selected under compatibility and API tradeoffs

initial_verification_problem.summary: The corrected Dafny resolver disallowed allocation-state-dependent function expressions in reads clauses. Seq.Filter used f.reads in its frame, so the linked Dafny correction made a standard-library change necessary to keep the library verifying.

repair_directions.description: Change Filter's exposed specification boundary: restrict f to a heap-independent arrow, restrict T to T(!new), use reads *, or use the ultimately adopted exact index-bounded union of f.reads(xs[i]).
repair_directions.verifier_confirmation_note: The adopted patch was merged and the author said it should not affect verification, but no public source directly shows a Dafny verifier run for this exact library alternative.

repair_directions.description: Fork the API into more than one Filter function, each accommodating one of the specification fixes, to avoid forcing one restriction or unbounded frame on every consumer.
repair_directions.verifier_confirmation_note: The API-fork direction was discussed, but the public history does not contain an implementation or verifier run for it.

E2.boundary_note: The multiple-Filter proposal is classified as implementation/adapter because it would add separate public entry points that accommodate distinct contracts; the other alternatives directly alter the callee's specification boundary.

final_adopted_repair.summary: Replace the broad interim reads * choice with an exact frame set: objects read by f at indices of xs. The final PR state was merged.

specification_api_decision.summary: Reviewers explicitly evaluated frame precision, restrictions on accepted functions and element types, possible consumer breakage, upgrade effort, API forking, and future backward compatibility. The author then selected an exact frame expression because it avoided the documented drawbacks, not merely because it was another edit that could satisfy the corrected resolver.

evidence_level_justification: E1, E2, and explicit E3 pass, but two distinct repair classes do not each have direct public VERIFIER_CONFIRMED evidence.
allowed_claim: This public workflow records multiple repair directions across different specification and API-implementation boundaries being considered in response to a Dafny verification problem, while the adopted choice was constrained by compatibility and specification considerations beyond verifier success alone.
claim_not_allowed: Multiple verifier-valid repairs existed, or this case proves any M3 property, prevalence claim, organizational grouping principle, or necessity result.

observation_inference.OBSERVED_SOURCE_FACT: Dafny PR 3609 links libraries PR 99 as a necessary standard-library change and says the corrected resolver rejects some functions in reads clauses.
observation_inference.OUR_INTERPRETATION: The library PR responds to a concrete verification-acceptance change rather than a hypothetical API redesign.
observation_inference.CLAIM_ALLOWED: A real Dafny verification problem initiated the library repair.
observation_inference.CLAIM_NOT_ALLOWED: The original Filter contract was semantically invalid in every Dafny version.

observation_inference.OBSERVED_SOURCE_FACT: PR 99 lists four fixes: restrict the function arrow, restrict T, broaden reads to *, or provide multiple Filter functions.
observation_inference.OUR_INTERPRETATION: The history directly crosses a callee-specification boundary and an implementation/API-adapter boundary.
observation_inference.CLAIM_ALLOWED: At least two repair classes were publicly considered.
observation_inference.CLAIM_NOT_ALLOWED: Every listed alternative was implemented or verified.

observation_inference.OBSERVED_SOURCE_FACT: A reviewer warns of consumer breakage and upgrade cost; the author later adopts an exact frame expression described as avoiding the listed drawbacks.
observation_inference.OUR_INTERPRETATION: Compatibility and specification precision constrained the selection independently of obtaining verifier acceptance.
observation_inference.CLAIM_ALLOWED: The adopted choice involved explicit API/specification judgment beyond verifier success.

observation_inference.OBSERVED_SOURCE_FACT: No public record directly demonstrates that two distinct alternatives each passed Dafny verification.
observation_inference.OUR_INTERPRETATION: The evidence supports R2 but not R3.
